honesty_boundary: This task defines a measure/metric-flow-compatible interface for F/W-style functionals, a monotonicity certificate with explicit analytic assumptions, checked algebraic consequences, and a statement-only bridge for missing integration-by-parts/regularity theorems. It is NOT a proof of Perelman's entropy monotonicity and NOT a proof of the Poincare conjecture. No declaration is named as a Perelman proof.

measure_metric_flow_interface.summary: EntropyData bundles a background measure mu, weight density rho (dm = rho dmu), scalar curvature density R, gradient-squared density, potential f, coupling tau > 0, dimension n, abstract dissipation density, nonnegativity of rho, and integrability of the F/W integrands. F = integral (R+|grad f|^2) dm; W = integral (tau(|grad f|^2+R)+f-n) dm.

explicit_analytic_assumptions: HasDerivAt (fun s => F (E s)) (dissipation t) t for every t > 0
sign of the dissipation (nonnegative for the monotone certificate, nonpositive for the antitone one)
integrability of the F/W integrands (fields of EntropyData)

checked_algebraic_consequences.name: ContinuousMonotoneCertificate.eq_on_Icc_of_eq_at
checked_algebraic_consequences.statement: F (E t) = F (E 0) and 0 <= t imply F constant on [0,t]

checked_algebraic_consequences.name: ContinuousAntitoneCertificate.eq_on_Icc_of_eq_at
checked_algebraic_consequences.statement: flat-spot rigidity for the antitone certificate

checked_algebraic_consequences.name: EntropyData.W_eq
checked_algebraic_consequences.statement: D.W = D.tau * D.F + D.extra (i.e. W = tau F + integral (f-n) dm)

unproved_statements: WeightedIBPStatement: integral (Delta_f u) v dm = - integral <grad u, grad v> dm
WeightedLaplacianStatement: Delta_f u = Delta u - <grad f, grad u>
BochnerStatement: Delta |grad u|^2 = 2 |Hess u|^2 + 2 <grad u, grad Delta u> + 2 Ric(grad u, grad u)
FDerivativeStatement: d/dt F = 2 integral |Ric + Hess f|^2 dm (differentiation under the integral sign)
EntropyFunctionalRegularityStatement: ContDiffOn R 1 (fun t => F (E t)) (Ici 0)
statement_only_bridge.checked_reduction: continuousMonotoneCertificateOfBridge : EntropyRegularityBridge C E -> (forall t >= 0, F (E t) <= B) -> ContinuousMonotoneCertificate E (derivative sign derived from FDissipation_nonneg)

results: finiteCurvatureDatum_F_zero (F equals D2 scalarCurvature K m.toScalarContractionData at zero potential)
finiteCurvatureDatum_W (W = tau F + sum (f - n) exp(-f))

blockers: FDerivativeStatement (differentiation under the integral sign / first variation of F) is an unproved Prop.
WeightedIBPStatement and BochnerStatement are unproved Props; the pinned mathlib has no Riemannian geometry API (D1 card).
ConjugateMeasureEvolutionStatement is an unproved Prop; the pinned mathlib has no heat-equation theory (D2 card).
EntropyFunctionalRegularityStatement (C^1 regularity of the functional) is an unproved Prop.
The one-sided bound fields (upper_le / lower_le) are explicit hypotheses, not derived.
WeightedCalculus is abstract data; no smooth manifold or metric is constructed.
